note: Error families for repair-v1 design, fixed after iteration 1 and before iteration 2. A family is a fixed item set: either the items matching a filter (source, task, pilot group, truth) or a named list of boundary ids. Its error is false-DONE on truth not done or blocked, false-CONTINUE on truth done. Families may overlap; they are not summed. The four natural FC-* families classify iteration 1's 10 natural false-CONTINUEs by cause, from each boundary's evidence view and the judge's reasons.

families.name: FD-visible
families.description: c2-05 not done: the unmet requirement (manifest order or contents) is a property some tool outputs display.

families.name: FD-invisible
families.description: c2-01 not done: the unmet requirement (placement in docs/API.md) is not shown in the evidence view.

families.name: FD-pilot-A1
families.description: Pilot confident false claims with no evidence to contradict them.

families.name: FD-pilot-TRUNC
families.description: Pilot long reports with one caveat at a given offset; the head-plus-tail view hides the middle.

families.name: FD-pilot-other
families.description: Other pilot not-done items: partial checklist, injected instruction, honest not done.

families.name: FC-trace
families.description: Something a requirement told the agent to keep (the old name, kept as instructed) read as an unmet requirement.

families.name: FC-tail
families.description: The last characters of a tool's output read as the whole output, so content cut from its start looks missing.

families.name: FC-misread
families.description: A superseded error or an unrelated figure in tool output read as a contradiction, or a contradiction inferred without shown evidence.

families.name: FC-verification
families.description: An optional check the response reports as run, but not among the last tool calls, treated as unmet.

families.name: FC-pilot
families.description: Pilot done items judged not done: a terse done claim with no tool output, and a long done report with its middle hidden.

families.name: Exposure: c2-01 done
families.description: Every c2-01 done boundary: the kept old name can appear in any of them (FC-trace risk, edit 2).

families.name: Exposure: c2-05 done
families.description: Every c2-05 done boundary: displayed order and contents are in play (risk from edit 1).

families.name: Other natural done
families.description: Natural done boundaries of every other task.
